analysis_steps.goal: Apply NRPCA and A-SPCA to original and Doppler-corrected data

method.value: NRPCA via dual covariance with noise-reduced eigenvalues; A-SPCA thresholds eigenvectors with omega = 1/2; 2D map vectorized by sorting along RA then dec

evidence.quote: In this paper, we set $\omega=1/2$
The value of $\omega=1/2$ was obtained by simulations.

findings_qualitative.value: PC1 traces line intensity and PC2 traces rotation in the original data; after Doppler correction PC2 traces small-scale (~10 pc) outflow, PC3/4 blueshifted flow matching the SW streamer root, and PC5 redshifted distortion.

evidence.quote: We find that the negative PC3 region agrees well with the root of the molecular outflow, named “SW streamer”.

claims.hypothesis: High-dimensional PCA works on an HDLSS ALMA spectral map with line shifts and broadening
claims.experiment: Applied NRPCA and A-SPCA to the original NGC 253 map
claims.result: Spiked eigenvalues; PC1 tracks intensity, PC2 tracks rotation; HCN and HNC features control PCs
claims.finding: The method works for spectral maps

evidence.quote: The performance of the A-SPCA to the ALMA spectroscopic map as HDLSS data is certainly guaranteed by this preparatory analysis.

claims.hypothesis: The method can extract outflow information after removing systemic rotation
claims.experiment: Applied to Doppler-corrected map and compared PC3 map to literature
claims.result: Negative-PC3 region coincides with the SW streamer root

evidence.quote: All these clues indicate that the high-dimensional PCA efficiently extract an outflow phenomenon from an ALMA spectroscopic map, in a purely objective way.

why_this_method.value: Traditional PCA is unreliable for n << d data; NRPCA reduces the noise bias and avoids prior knowledge of line frequencies.

evidence.quote: While some frequency regions are considered to contain no information, we proceeded extracting information not by traditional procedure, but by an objective statistical method without a prior information.

limitations_admitted.value: Neighboring spectral channels are not independent due to line broadening, and continuum is not treated.

evidence.quote: Then, the information carried by each spectral resolution unit is not independent

referee_caveats_inferred: Mainly qualitative comparison with literature outflow, no quantitative test
Spatial pixels are correlated and i.i.d. assumption is not satisfied
Frequency gaps and Doppler cropping lose spectral information
